Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1318
Claimant:
Angela Vargas
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
04/20/2025
Claim opened after the insuerd reported being struck while turning left at an intersection. The claimant is represented
by counsel, and all furtehr contact will be routed through the attorney's office.
04/24/2025
Recorded statement taken from the claimant, who described the collision and the pain felt in the neck and lower back
immediately after. The account matched the first-notice report in every detail.
04/29/2025
Responding officer's report obtained. It places the claimant in the passenger seat of the vehicle at the time of impact
and records the other driver's account of the left turn.
05/09/2025
Photos from the scene and the other driver's statement reviewed. Both describe the collision the same way as the
claimant, and two independent witnesses have confirmed the sequence of events.
05/23/2025
Vehicle inspected and the damage to the front quarter panel and bumper is consistent with the impact described. No
prior damage to the vehicle appears in the file or in the records checked.
07/08/2025
Policy confirmed in force at the time of loss, and the driver is listed as a named insured. Nothing in the underwriting
history points to damage predating the start of coverage.
09/03/2025
Medical records received. The neck and back strain diagnosis fits the type and force of the crash, and no earlier
treatment to either area is on record with the providers or prior carriers checked.
10/12/2025
Treatment billing has risen to many times the typical course for this kind of strain, with near-daily visits. Several
weeks after the accident, the claimant reported pain in an additional body area not mentioned at first.
11/04/2025
Claimant has given the same account in each conversation so far. Medical review is requested to confirm the
treamtent plan against accepted guidelines before the file is evaluated further.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
